AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. Supersedes AaveV3_Gnosis, disabled below.

StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every StakeWise V3 vault on Gnosis. Emits a Staking leg (vault shares) and a Borrow leg (osGNO debt) per vault, both denominated in the underlying staking asset GNO. The active vault set is configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters/100.json (this deploy-config holds only the constructor args) and governed on NAVCalculator via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances. underlyingToken = GNO (Gnosis stakes GNO, mints osGNO). osTokenVaultController is the same Gnosis controller osGNO_CustomPriceFeed uses. Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = vault name().

UniswapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every configured Uniswap V3 pool on Gnosis via on-chain NFT enumeration (the NPM is ERC721Enumerable). Only the NonfungiblePositionManager is pinned in the constructor; the active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (nav-config instances). ADDRESS TRAP - THREE Uniswap V3 deployments exist on Gnosis, all by the same deployer (0x88bcb4e3...6d95), and all three NonfungiblePositionManagers answer symbol() == 'UNI-V3-POS' and supportsInterface(ERC721Enumerable) == true. The other two (0xd6053798...7537 -> factory 0x581e2A6e..., 0x49B53C35...2C71 -> factory 0x963Df249...) have totalSupply == 0 and are dead. This one is the live deployment: its factory() is 0xe32F7dD7e3f098D518ff19A22d5f028e076489B1, the address the Gnosis analytics docs publish, and it had 4143 positions minted when this was wired (verified on-chain 2026-08-26). Pin the NPM by its factory(), never by symbol.

LidoStakedEthWalletMeta.$comment: Wallet-held yield tokens (ADR 0010 meta family). Reports the RAW balanceOf of a token that is itself a registered, priced NAV asset, so the reported amount is bit-identical to what ERC20DefaultBalanceAdapter reported for the same holding - this reclassifies wstETH (Lido) from a generic wallet holding to a Staking position and changes NO value. Constructor takes only the NAV proxy, so the CREATE2 address is identical on every chain. The governed token set lives on NAVCalculator (see nav-config); claiming a token there automatically disarms the default adapter for it, so the two can never both report the same holding.
